inputs.document:
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited and The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited take no responsibility for the contents of this announcement, make no representation as to its accuracy or completeness and expressly disclaim any liability whatsoever for any loss howsoever arising from or in reliance upon the whole or any part of the contents of this announcement.

BFB HEALTH LIMITED
(Incorporated in the Cayman Islands and continued in Bermuda with limited liability)
(Stock Code: 205)

DISCLOSEABLE TRANSACTION DISPOSAL OF A SUBSIDIARY

On 28 September 2026, the Company and the Purchaser entered into the Share Transfer Agreement, pursuant to which the Company has agreed to sell and the Purchaser has agreed to purchase the Sale Share, representing 100% of the issued share capital of the Disposal Company for a consideration of HK$10,000.

Upon Completion, the Disposal Company will no longer be a subsidiary of the Company, and the Company will cease to hold any of the issued share capital of the Disposal Company. Accordingly, the financial results of the Disposal Company will no longer be consolidated into the consolidated financial statements of the Group.

LISTING RULES IMPLICATIONS

As the applicable percentage ratios under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal exceeds 5% but are below 25%, the Disposal constitutes a disclosable transaction for the Company and is therefore subject to the reporting and announcement requirements under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules.

INTRODUCTION

On 28 September 2026, the Company and the Purchaser entered into the Share Transfer Agreement, pursuant to which the Company has agreed to sell and the Purchaser has agreed to purchase the Sale Share for a consideration of HK$10,000. Details of the Share Transfer Agreement are set out in this announcement below.

SHARE TRANSFER AGREEMENT

The principal terms of the Share Transfer Agreement are set out as follows:

Date: 28 September 2026

Parties: (1) the Company, as the Vendor;

And

(2) the Purchaser

The Purchaser is an individual, to the best of the Directors’ knowledge, information and belief having made all reasonable enquiries, the Purchaser is Independent Third Parties as at the date of this announcement.

Subject matter: The Company conditionally agreed to sell and the Purchaser conditionally agreed to acquire the Sale Share, representing 100% of the issued share capital of the Disposal Company.

Consideration: HK$10,000

Payment terms: The sum of HK$10,000 shall be paid by the Purchaser to the Company on 28 September 2026.

The Consideration was determined after arm’s length negotiations between the parties with reference to the unaudited management account of the Disposal Group for the six months ended 30 June 2026 and the financial performance of the Disposal Group.

Completion of the Disposal took place immediately after signing of the Share Transfer Agreement.

INFORMATION OF THE GROUP

The Company is an investment holding company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and continued in Bermuda with limited liability. The Group is principally engaged in the provision of advertising agency services, e-commerce business and money lending business and in the PRC and in Hong Kong.

INFORMATION ON THE DISPOSAL GROUP

The Disposal Company is a limited liability company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands which is beneficially owned as to 100% by the Company as at the date of the Share Transfer Agreement.

The Disposal Company is an investment company. The Disposal Group is mainly engaged in the advertising and e-commerce business in the PRC.

The audited consolidated financial results of the Disposal Group for the two years ended 31 December 2025 and 2024 which are prepared in accordance with the accounting principles generally accepted in Hong Kong and its contribution to the Group are as follows:

For the year ended 31 December
2025 | 2024
HK$’000 | HK$’000

Revenue | 3,162 | 11,546
Loss from operations | 2,280 | 6,858

The Disposal Group recorded unaudited net liabilities (excluding intercompany loans) of approximately HK$33.3 million as at 30 June 2026.

FINANCIAL EFFECT OF THE DISPOSAL

Upon Completion, the Group will no longer have any interest in the Disposal Company and the Disposal Company will cease to be accounted as a subsidiary of the Group. Accordingly, the financial results of the Disposal Group will no longer be consolidated into the consolidated financial statement of the Group.

The estimated gain on the Disposal attributable to the owner of the Company based on the unaudited net liabilities of the Disposal Group (excluding intercompany loans) less the Consideration as at 30 June 2026 is approximately HK$33.3 million.

The actual amount of gain or loss as a result of the Disposal to be recorded by the Company will be subject to the review and final audit by the auditors of the Company. The proceeds from the Disposal are currently intended to be used by the Group as general working capital.

REASONS FOR AND BENEFITS OF THE DISPOSAL

Considering the financial performance and after reviewing the business and operation status of the Disposal Group, the Board considers that it is appropriate for the Group to proceed with the Disposal. The Disposal will strengthen the cash flow of the Group allowing the Group to improve its liquidity and allow the Group to reallocate its resources to other existing opportunities.

The net proceeds from the Disposal will be used as the Group’s general working capital.

Based on the above, the Directors are of the view that the terms of the Disposal are fair and reasonable and in the interests of the Company and the Shareholders as a whole.

LISTING RULES IMPLICATIONS

As the applicable percentage ratios under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal exceeds 5% but are below 25%, the Disposal constitutes a discloseable transaction for the Company and is therefore subject to the reporting and announcement requirements under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules.

DEFINITIONS

In this announcement, unless the context requires otherwise, the following expressions have the following meanings:

“Board” the board of Directors

“Business Day(s)” a day (not being a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday) on which banks generally are open for business in Hong Kong

“Company” or “Vendor” BFB Health Limited, a company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and continued in Bermuda with limited liability and the shares of which are listed on Main Board of the Stock Exchange (stock code: 205)

“Completion” completion of the Disposal

“Completion Date” upon signing the Share Transfer Agreement

“connected person(s)” has the meaning ascribed to it under the Listing Rules

“Consideration” HK$10,000 to be paid by the Purchaser to the Company in cash

“Director(s)” the director(s) of the Company

“Disposal” the sale of the Sale Shares by the Company to the Purchaser

“Disposal Company” Golden Gate China Limited, a company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands with limited liability on 08 June 2006, and a direct wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company before Completion

“Disposal Group” the Disposal Company and its subsidiaries

“Group” the Company and its subsidiaries

“HK$” Hong Kong dollar, the lawful currency of Hong Kong

“Hong Kong” the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China

“Independent Third Party(ies)” any person(s) or company(ies) and their respective ultimate beneficial owner(s), to the best of the Directors’ knowledge, information and belief having made all reasonable enquiries, is/are not connected persons of the Company and is/are third party(ies) independent of the Company and its connected person(s) in accordance with the Listing Rules

“Listing Rules” the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited

“PRC” The People’s Republic of China

“Purchaser” an individual who, to the best of the Directors ’ knowledge, information and belief having made all reasonable enquiries, is an Independent Third Party

“Sale Share” 100% of the issued share capital of the Disposal Company

“Shareholders” shareholder(s) of the Company

“Share Transfer Agreement” the share transfer agreement dated 28 September 2026 entered into between the Company and the Purchaser in relation to the Disposal

“Stock Exchange” The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited

“%” per cent.

By Order of the Board
BFB Health Limited
Li Leong
Executive Director

Hong Kong, 28 September 2026

As at the date of this announcement, the executive Directors of the Company are Mr. Li Leong, Mr. Wu Mansheng, Mr. Li Zhen and Mr. Zhou Hongtao; and the independent non-executive Directors are Mr. Law Chi Hung, Mr. Guo Hui and Ms. Fang Ying.

rationale.H1: 公告写明 “the applicable percentage ratios under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal exceeds 5% but are below 25%, the Disposal constitutes a disclosable transaction”，分类与比率区间都和问卷的须予披露交易一致；条目只要求公告写明二者，没有规模测试表不构成需补材料。
rationale.H2: 公告第一页最上方、公司名称之前的第一段是 “Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited and The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited take no responsibility for the contents of this announcement, ...”，与批准文本逐字一致。
rationale.H3: 首页公司名称下有 “(Stock Code: 205)”，文末 “As at the date of this announcement, the executive Directors of the Company are Mr. Li Leong, Mr. Wu Mansheng, Mr. Li Zhen and Mr. Zhou Hongtao; and the independent non-executive Directors are Mr. Law Chi Hung, Mr. Guo Hui and Ms. Fang Ying.” 列出全部董事姓名。
rationale.H4: 发行人主要业务已写（“The Group is principally engaged in the provision of advertising agency services, e-commerce business and money lending business”），但交易对手只写 “The Purchaser is an individual”，释义也只是 “an individual who ... is an Independent Third Party”，没有姓名，也没有职业或背景，按团队口径为未写明身份，第②③项都缺。
rationale.H5: 正文称 “the Purchaser is Independent Third Parties”，释义 “Independent Third Party(ies)” 已包含 “their respective ultimate beneficial owner(s), to the best of the Directors’ knowledge, information and belief having made all reasonable enquiries ... independent of the Company and its connected person(s)”，按条目口径视为符合，公告也没有任何地方称买方为关连人士。
rationale.H6: 公告写明交易性质为出售 Sale Share（Disposal Company 全部已发行股本）、日期 “Date: 28 September 2026”、代价 HK$10,000 及 “The sum of HK$10,000 shall be paid by the Purchaser to the Company on 28 September 2026”（释义写明以现金支付），并写明厘定基础 “with reference to the unaudited management account of the Disposal Group for the six months ended 30 June 2026 and the financial performance of the Disposal Group”，四项齐备。
rationale.H7: 标的简介（Golden Gate China Limited，BVI 投资公司，“The Disposal Group is mainly engaged in the advertising and e-commerce business in the PRC”）和账面值（“unaudited net liabilities (excluding intercompany loans) of approximately HK$33.3 million as at 30 June 2026”）已写，但两年财务数据只有 “Revenue” 和 “Loss from operations” 两行，没有除税及非经常项目前、后的净利润，属条目明示的“只写收入、经营亏损”不一致情形。
rationale.H8: 公告写明理由（“Considering the financial performance and after reviewing the business and operation status of the Disposal Group”）、益处（“strengthen the cash flow of the Group allowing the Group to improve its liquidity”）及 “the Directors are of the view that the terms of the Disposal are fair and reasonable and in the interests of the Company and the Shareholders as a whole”。
rationale.H9: 公告和背景都没有提到本交易涉及任何担保或抵押，条目写明“公告和背景都没有提到担保或抵押，为符合”；触发条件不存在，所以同时接受 not_applicable。
rationale.H10: 本交易为出售附属公司，公告写明预计收益及计算基础（“The estimated gain on the Disposal ... based on the unaudited net liabilities of the Disposal Group (excluding intercompany loans) less the Consideration as at 30 June 2026 is approximately HK$33.3 million”）、所得款项用途（“general working capital”）以及 “Upon Completion, the Disposal Company will no longer be a subsidiary of the Company”，三项齐备。
rationale.H11: 问卷分类为须予披露交易，本条只适用于主要交易、非常重大收购或出售（applies_when classification），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H12: 问卷关连人士答“否”，本条只适用于关连交易（applies_when connected=是），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H13: 问卷关连人士答“否”，本条只适用于关连交易（applies_when connected=是），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H14: 问卷关连人士答“否”，本条只适用于关连交易（applies_when connected=是），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H15: 问卷关连人士答“否”，本条只适用于关连交易（applies_when connected=是），由代码判为不适用。

cases.notes: 真实刊发公告，非关连、须予披露、出售附属公司。测试三点：①刊发公告仍有两处按条目口径不合格（H4 买方为个人却没有姓名和背景；H7 两年数据只有收入和经营亏损，没有除税前后净利润），模型须判 issue；②没有规模测试表时，公告已写明分类和比率区间，H1 应判符合而不是需补材料；③H5 须识别释义中的独立第三方定义已含最终实益拥有人与确认语。H11–H15 由代码判不适用。

cases.title: AEON Stores（00984）2026-08-12 须予披露兼关连交易：出售上市证券，按刊发原文

inputs.document:
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited and The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited take no responsibility for the contents of this announcement, make no representation as to its accuracy or completeness and expressly disclaim any liability whatsoever for any loss howsoever arising from or in reliance upon the whole or any part of the contents of this announcement.

AEON STORES (HONG KONG) CO., LIMITED
永旺(香港)百貨有限公司
(Incorporated in Hong Kong with limited liability)
(Stock code: 984)

DISCLOSEABLE TRANSACTION AND CONNECTED TRANSACTION IN RELATION TO THE DISPOSAL OF LISTED SECURITIES

The Board wishes to announce that on 12 August 2026 (after trading hours of the Stock Exchange), the Company (as vendor) entered into the SPA with the Purchaser (as purchaser), pursuant to which the Company has agreed to sell, and the Purchaser has agreed to purchase, the Disposal Shares (comprising 683,500 Shares, representing approximately 0.16% of the total issued Shares as at the date of this announcement) at the price of HK$8.83 per Disposal Share with a total consideration of HK$6,035,305 (before transaction costs).

As one or more of the applicable percentage ratios as defined under Rule 14.07 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal exceed 5% but are all below 25%, the Disposal constitutes a discloseable transaction for the Company and is therefore subject to the notification and announcement requirements under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules.

As at the date of this announcement, the Purchaser is a connected person of the Company by virtue of it being a 30%-controlled company of AEON Co, the controlling shareholder of the Company holding approximately 60.59% interest in the Company. Accordingly, the Disposal constitutes a connected transaction for the Company under Chapter 14A of the Listing Rules. As all the applicable percentage ratios (other than the profits ratio) as defined under Rule 14.07 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal are below 25% and the total Consideration is less than HK$10,000,000.00, pursuant to Rule 14A.76(2)(b), the Disposal is subject to the reporting and announcement requirements but is exempt from the circular and shareholders’ approval requirements under Chapter 14A of the Listing Rules.

THE DISPOSAL

The Board wishes to announce that on 12 August 2026 (after trading hours of the Stock Exchange), the Company (as vendor) entered into the SPA with the Purchaser (as purchaser), pursuant to which the Company has agreed to sell, and the Purchaser has agreed to purchase, the Disposal Shares (comprising 683,500 Shares, representing approximately 0.16% of the total issued Shares as at the date of this announcement) at the price of HK$8.83 per Disposal Share with a total Consideration of HK$6,035,305 (before transaction costs).

THE SPA

The principal terms of the SPA are as follows:

Date: 12 August 2026

Parties: The Company, as vendor, and the Purchaser, as purchaser

Subject Matter: The Company agrees to sell, and the Purchaser agrees to purchase, the Disposal Shares, comprising 683,500 Shares, representing approximately 0.16% of the total issued shares of AEON Credit as at the date of this announcement

Consideration: The total Consideration is HK$6,035,305. The Consideration of HK$8.83 per Disposal Share represented the closing price of the Shares as quoted on the Stock Exchange on the Last Trading Day. The Consideration represented the market price of the Disposal Shares at the time of Disposal. The Consideration was determined with reference to, among others, (i) the prevailing market price of the Disposal Shares; and (ii) the factors set out in the section headed ‘‘Reason for and Benefits of the Disposal and Use of Proceeds’’.

Payment terms: The Consideration shall be settled by bank transfer in Hong Kong dollars on the date of Completion by the Purchaser to the Company’s designated account.

Conditions precedent: Completion is subject to the following conditions being satisfied: (i) compliance with all applicable laws, rules and regulations (including but not limited to the Listing Rules) by the Company in relation to the SPA and the transaction contemplated thereunder; and (ii) all authorisations, approvals, consents, waivers and permits which are necessary or relevant to give effect to the SPA and the transaction contemplated thereunder having been complied with, granted, received or obtained by the Company and the Purchaser and remain in full force and effect and not revoked up to the date of Completion.

Completion: Completion shall take place within five (5) business days upon fulfillment of all conditions precedent set out in the SPA, or such later date as mutually agreed by the Company and the Purchaser in writing.

FINANCIAL EFFECT OF THE DISPOSAL

As at the date of this announcement, the Company holds 783,500 Shares, representing approximately 0.19% of the total issued shares of AEON Credit. Assuming there is no change in the total issued shares of AEON Credit from the date of this announcement to the date of Completion, the Company will remain interested in a total of 100,000 Shares in AEON Credit upon Completion, representing approximately 0.02% of the total issued shares of AEON Credit. Accordingly, the remaining equity interest in AEON Credit held by the Company will remain to be recorded as ‘‘financial assets at fair value through profit or loss’’.

Upon Completion, the Group expects to recognise an unaudited gain from the Disposal (before transaction costs) of approximately HK$239,225, which is calculated as the difference between (i) the carrying value of the Disposal Shares of approximately HK$5,796,080.00 and (ii) the total Consideration of HK$6,035,305.00. The actual gain or loss from the Disposal to be recorded by the Group shall be subject to the review and audit by the auditor of the Company and may be different from the estimated amount.

The Group intends to use the proceeds from the Disposal (after deducting related fees and expenses) for the Group’s general working capital.

REASONS FOR AND BENEFITS OF THE DISPOSAL AND USE OF PROCEEDS

The principal business of the Group is the operation of retail businesses through chain stores under the trade name of ‘‘AEON STYLE’’, ‘‘AEON’’ and ‘‘AEON SUPERMARKET’’ in Hong Kong and the PRC.

Based on the recent market prices of AEON Credit, the Directors are of the view that the Disposal represented an opportunity to realise part of the Company’s investment in the Disposal Shares so as to strengthen the cash position of the Group and will allow the Group to reallocate more financial resources on the general working capital of the Group.

The Directors, including all the independent non-executive Directors, are of the view that notwithstanding the Disposal is not in the ordinary and usual course of business of the Group, the Group’s divestment in the Shares could generate general working capital for the Group and the terms of the Disposal set out in the SPA (including the Consideration) are on normal commercial terms or better, fair and reasonable and in the interests of the Company and its shareholders as a whole.

At the Board meeting convened to consider the Disposal and the SPA, Mr. Tsukasa Konno, Mr. Takenori Nagashima, Mr. Shinya Hisanaga, Mr. Wei Aiguo and Mr. Yasutoshi Yokochi were regarded as potentially having a material interest in the SPA and the Disposal and accordingly abstained from voting on the relevant resolutions.

LISTING RULES IMPLICATIONS

As one or more of the applicable percentage ratios as defined under Rule 14.07 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal exceed 5% but are all below 25%, the Disposal constitutes a discloseable transaction for the Company and is therefore subject to the notification and announcement requirements under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules.

As at the date of this announcement, the Purchaser is a connected person of the Company by virtue of it being a 30%-controlled company (as defined in the Listing Rules) of AEON Co, the controlling shareholder of the Company holding approximately 60.59% interest in the Company. Accordingly, the Disposal constitutes a connected transaction for the Company under Chapter 14A of the Listing Rules. As all the applicable percentage ratios (other than the profits ratio) as defined under Rule 14.07 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal are below 25% and the total Consideration is less than HK$10,000,000.00, pursuant to Rule 14A.76(2)(b), the Disposal is subject to the reporting and announcement requirements but is exempt from the circular and shareholders’ approval requirements under Chapter 14A of the Listing Rules.

INFORMATION ABOUT THE PARTIES

The Company and the Group

The Group is principally engaged in the operation of general merchandise stores in Hong Kong and the PRC.

AEON Credit and the Purchaser

AEON Credit is a company incorporated in Hong Kong with limited liability and its shares are listed on the Stock Exchange (stock code: 900). As at the date of this announcement and prior to Completion, shareholders of AEON Credit include the Purchaser (holding approximately 54.04% of the issued shares of AEON Credit), AEON Co (holding approximately 13.37% of the issued shares of AEON Credit) and the Company (holding approximately 0.19% of the issued shares of AEON Credit).

Certain key financial information of AEON Credit as extracted from its published audited financial statements for the years ended 28 February 2025 and 2026 are set out as follows:

For the years ended
28 February
2025 | 2026
HK$’000 | HK$’000
(audited) | (audited)

Net profit before tax | 478,816 | 561,844
Net profit after tax | 400,478 | 468,199

The audited net asset value of AEON Credit as at 28 February 2026 was approximately HK$4,484 million.

The Purchaser group (including the Purchaser and AEON Credit) is principally engaged in the provision of consumer finance services, which include the issuance of credit cards and the provision of personal loan financing, insurance agency and brokerage business, and microfinance business.

As at the date of this announcement, the Purchaser is directly wholly owned by AEON Financial Service Co., Ltd. (a company incorporated in Japan with limited liability, the shares of which are listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange), which is in turn directly held as to approximately 48.18% by AEON Co (the controlling shareholder of the Company and the issued shares of which are listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange).

DEFINITIONS

In this announcement, the following expressions have the following meanings unless the context requires otherwise.

‘‘AEON Co’’ AEON Co., Ltd., a company incorporated in Japan with limited liability, the issued shares of which are listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange

‘‘AEON Credit’’ AEON Credit Service (Asia) Company Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong with limited liability, the shares of which are listed on the Stock Exchange (stock code: 900)

‘‘Board’’ the board of Directors

‘‘Company’’ AEON Stores (Hong Kong) Co., Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong with limited liability, the shares of which are listed on the Stock Exchange (stock code: 984)

‘‘Completion’’ completion of the Disposal under the SPA

‘‘connected person’’ has the meaning ascribed thereto under the Listing Rules

‘‘Consideration’’ the consideration for the Disposal pursuant to the SPA

‘‘controlling shareholder’’ has the meaning ascribed thereto under the Listing Rules

‘‘Director(s)’’ the director(s) of the Company

‘‘Disposal’’ the disposal of the 683,500 Shares in AEON Credit held by the Company to the Purchaser pursuant to the SPA

‘‘Disposal Share(s)’’ the 683,500 Shares in AEON Credit subject to the Disposal pursuant to the SPA

‘‘Group’’ the Company and its subsidiaries

‘‘HK$’’ Hong Kong dollars, the lawful currency of Hong Kong

‘‘Hong Kong’’ the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the PRC

‘‘Last Trading Day’’ the last trading day of the Shares on the Stock Exchange immediately before the date of the SPA

‘‘Listing Rules’’ the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on the Stock Exchange

‘‘Purchaser’’ AEON Financial Service (Hong Kong) Co., Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong with limited liability

‘‘PRC’’ the People’s Republic of China, which for the purpose of this announcement, excludes Hong Kong, the Macau Special Administrative Region of the PRC and Taiwan

‘‘Share(s)’’ share(s) in the ordinary share capital of AEON Credit which are listed on the Stock Exchange

‘‘SPA’’ the Sale and Purchase Agreement dated 12 August 2026 entered into by the Company and the Purchaser in respect of the Disposal

‘‘Stock Exchange’’ The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited

‘‘%’’ per cent.

By Order of the Board
AEON Stores (Hong Kong) Co., Limited
Tsukasa KONNO
Chairman

Hong Kong, 12 August 2026

As at the date of this announcement, the Executive Directors are Mr. Takenori Nagashima and Mr. Shinya Hisanaga; the Non-executive Directors are Mr. Tsukasa Konno, Mr. Wei Aiguo and Mr. Yasutoshi Yokochi; and the Independent Non-executive Directors are Mr. Hideto Mizuno, Ms. Shum Wing Ting and Ms. Wong Mei Ling.

rationale.H1: 公告写明 “As one or more of the applicable percentage ratios as defined under Rule 14.07 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal exceed 5% but are all below 25%, the Disposal constitutes a discloseable transaction”，分类与比率区间都和问卷一致。
rationale.H2: 公告第一页最上方、公司名称之前的第一段与批准文本逐字一致（“... take no responsibility for the contents of this announcement ...”）。
rationale.H3: 首页公司名称下有 “(Stock code: 984)”，文末 “As at the date of this announcement, the Executive Directors are Mr. Takenori Nagashima and Mr. Shinya Hisanaga; the Non-executive Directors are ...; and the Independent Non-executive Directors are ...” 列出全部八名董事姓名。
rationale.H4: 公告写明发行人主要业务（“The Group is principally engaged in the operation of general merchandise stores in Hong Kong and the PRC”）、交易对手全称及注册地（“AEON Financial Service (Hong Kong) Co., Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong with limited liability”）及其主要业务（“The Purchaser group (including the Purchaser and AEON Credit) is principally engaged in the provision of consumer finance services”）。
rationale.H5: 问卷关连人士答“是”，本条只适用于非关连交易（applies_when connected=否），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H6: 公告写明买卖 683,500 股 AEON Credit 股份（上市证券，没有写出售限制，条目允许不写）、日期 “Date: 12 August 2026”、代价 HK$6,035,305（每股 HK$8.83）及 “settled by bank transfer in Hong Kong dollars on the date of Completion”，并写明厘定基础 “with reference to, among others, (i) the prevailing market price of the Disposal Shares”。
rationale.H7: 公告写明标的公司名称、上市地位及业务（AEON Credit，“stock code: 900”，消费金融），账面值 “the carrying value of the Disposal Shares of approximately HK$5,796,080.00”，以及 AEON Credit 截至 2025 年及 2026 年 2 月 28 日两个财政年度的 “Net profit before tax” 和 “Net profit after tax”，两个口径各两年。
rationale.H8: 公告写明理由（“the Disposal represented an opportunity to realise part of the Company’s investment in the Disposal Shares”）、益处（“strengthen the cash position of the Group”）及 “The Directors, including all the independent non-executive Directors, are of the view that ... fair and reasonable and in the interests of the Company and its shareholders as a whole”。
rationale.H9: 公告和背景都没有提到本交易涉及任何担保或抵押，条目写明“公告和背景都没有提到担保或抵押，为符合”；触发条件不存在，所以同时接受 not_applicable。
rationale.H10: 本交易为出售，公告写明预计收益约 HK$239,225 “calculated as the difference between (i) the carrying value of the Disposal Shares of approximately HK$5,796,080.00 and (ii) the total Consideration”、所得款项 “for the Group’s general working capital”；AEON Credit 只是约 0.19% 的投资、不是附属公司，第③项不触发。
rationale.H11: 问卷分类为须予披露交易，本条只适用于主要交易、非常重大收购或出售（applies_when classification），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H12: 关连关系（“a 30%-controlled company of AEON Co, the controlling shareholder of the Company holding approximately 60.59% interest in the Company”）和买方作为购买方的利益已写，持股链也写到 “directly wholly owned by AEON Financial Service Co., Ltd. ... which is in turn directly held as to approximately 48.18% by AEON Co”，但对 AEON Financial Service Co., Ltd. 和 AEON Co 只写注册地和上市地，没有写最终实益拥有人的主要业务，缺第①项。
rationale.H13: 公告写明获豁免股东批准和通函，独立非执行董事意见覆盖日常业务（“notwithstanding the Disposal is not in the ordinary and usual course of business of the Group”）、一般商务条款、公平合理及符合整体利益（“on normal commercial terms or better, fair and reasonable and in the interests of the Company and its shareholders as a whole”），并声明五名董事 “were regarded as potentially having a material interest ... and accordingly abstained from voting on the relevant resolutions”，两部分齐备。
rationale.H14: 本交易是本集团出售资产（不是向关连人士收购），公告只写 “the Company holds 783,500 Shares”，公告和背景都没有说明本集团持有 AEON Credit 股份多久，按条目为需补材料：请确认持有期限，不超过 12 个月的须写明原收购成本。
rationale.H15: 公告写明 “the Disposal is subject to the reporting and announcement requirements but is exempt from the circular and shareholders’ approval requirements under Chapter 14A of the Listing Rules”，条目明示“公告写明本交易获豁免股东批准及通函规定，为符合”。

cases.notes: 真实刊发公告，关连交易获第 14A.76(2)(b) 条豁免股东批准和通函。测试关连条目：H13 须按公告自述的豁免安排检查独立非执行董事意见和董事放弃投票（均齐备）；H15 豁免表述为符合；H14 出售资产但没有写持有期限，须判需补材料而不是不适用或符合；H12 公告写了持股链却没有写最终实益拥有人（AEON Financial Service Co., Ltd. / AEON Co）的主要业务，按条目第①项判 issue。H5 由代码判不适用。

cases.title: BFB Health 公告删去免责声明和代价厘定基础两处（缺漏检测）

inputs.document:
BFB HEALTH LIMITED
(Incorporated in the Cayman Islands and continued in Bermuda with limited liability)
(Stock Code: 205)

DISCLOSEABLE TRANSACTION DISPOSAL OF A SUBSIDIARY

On 28 September 2026, the Company and the Purchaser entered into the Share Transfer Agreement, pursuant to which the Company has agreed to sell and the Purchaser has agreed to purchase the Sale Share, representing 100% of the issued share capital of the Disposal Company for a consideration of HK$10,000.

Upon Completion, the Disposal Company will no longer be a subsidiary of the Company, and the Company will cease to hold any of the issued share capital of the Disposal Company. Accordingly, the financial results of the Disposal Company will no longer be consolidated into the consolidated financial statements of the Group.

LISTING RULES IMPLICATIONS

As the applicable percentage ratios under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal exceeds 5% but are below 25%, the Disposal constitutes a disclosable transaction for the Company and is therefore subject to the reporting and announcement requirements under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules.

INTRODUCTION

On 28 September 2026, the Company and the Purchaser entered into the Share Transfer Agreement, pursuant to which the Company has agreed to sell and the Purchaser has agreed to purchase the Sale Share for a consideration of HK$10,000. Details of the Share Transfer Agreement are set out in this announcement below.

SHARE TRANSFER AGREEMENT

The principal terms of the Share Transfer Agreement are set out as follows:

Date: 28 September 2026

Parties: (1) the Company, as the Vendor;

And

(2) the Purchaser

The Purchaser is an individual, to the best of the Directors’ knowledge, information and belief having made all reasonable enquiries, the Purchaser is Independent Third Parties as at the date of this announcement.

Subject matter: The Company conditionally agreed to sell and the Purchaser conditionally agreed to acquire the Sale Share, representing 100% of the issued share capital of the Disposal Company.

Consideration: HK$10,000

Payment terms: The sum of HK$10,000 shall be paid by the Purchaser to the Company on 28 September 2026.

Completion of the Disposal took place immediately after signing of the Share Transfer Agreement.

INFORMATION OF THE GROUP

The Company is an investment holding company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and continued in Bermuda with limited liability. The Group is principally engaged in the provision of advertising agency services, e-commerce business and money lending business and in the PRC and in Hong Kong.

INFORMATION ON THE DISPOSAL GROUP

The Disposal Company is a limited liability company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands which is beneficially owned as to 100% by the Company as at the date of the Share Transfer Agreement.

The Disposal Company is an investment company. The Disposal Group is mainly engaged in the advertising and e-commerce business in the PRC.

The audited consolidated financial results of the Disposal Group for the two years ended 31 December 2025 and 2024 which are prepared in accordance with the accounting principles generally accepted in Hong Kong and its contribution to the Group are as follows:

For the year ended 31 December
2025 | 2024
HK$’000 | HK$’000

Revenue | 3,162 | 11,546
Loss from operations | 2,280 | 6,858

The Disposal Group recorded unaudited net liabilities (excluding intercompany loans) of approximately HK$33.3 million as at 30 June 2026.

FINANCIAL EFFECT OF THE DISPOSAL

Upon Completion, the Group will no longer have any interest in the Disposal Company and the Disposal Company will cease to be accounted as a subsidiary of the Group. Accordingly, the financial results of the Disposal Group will no longer be consolidated into the consolidated financial statement of the Group.

The estimated gain on the Disposal attributable to the owner of the Company based on the unaudited net liabilities of the Disposal Group (excluding intercompany loans) less the Consideration as at 30 June 2026 is approximately HK$33.3 million.

The actual amount of gain or loss as a result of the Disposal to be recorded by the Company will be subject to the review and final audit by the auditors of the Company. The proceeds from the Disposal are currently intended to be used by the Group as general working capital.

REASONS FOR AND BENEFITS OF THE DISPOSAL

Considering the financial performance and after reviewing the business and operation status of the Disposal Group, the Board considers that it is appropriate for the Group to proceed with the Disposal. The Disposal will strengthen the cash flow of the Group allowing the Group to improve its liquidity and allow the Group to reallocate its resources to other existing opportunities.

The net proceeds from the Disposal will be used as the Group’s general working capital.

Based on the above, the Directors are of the view that the terms of the Disposal are fair and reasonable and in the interests of the Company and the Shareholders as a whole.

LISTING RULES IMPLICATIONS

As the applicable percentage ratios under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal exceeds 5% but are below 25%, the Disposal constitutes a discloseable transaction for the Company and is therefore subject to the reporting and announcement requirements under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules.

DEFINITIONS

In this announcement, unless the context requires otherwise, the following expressions have the following meanings:

“Board” the board of Directors

“Business Day(s)” a day (not being a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday) on which banks generally are open for business in Hong Kong

“Company” or “Vendor” BFB Health Limited, a company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and continued in Bermuda with limited liability and the shares of which are listed on Main Board of the Stock Exchange (stock code: 205)

“Completion” completion of the Disposal

“Completion Date” upon signing the Share Transfer Agreement

“connected person(s)” has the meaning ascribed to it under the Listing Rules

“Consideration” HK$10,000 to be paid by the Purchaser to the Company in cash

“Director(s)” the director(s) of the Company

“Disposal” the sale of the Sale Shares by the Company to the Purchaser

“Disposal Company” Golden Gate China Limited, a company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands with limited liability on 08 June 2006, and a direct wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company before Completion

“Disposal Group” the Disposal Company and its subsidiaries

“Group” the Company and its subsidiaries

“HK$” Hong Kong dollar, the lawful currency of Hong Kong

“Hong Kong” the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China

“Independent Third Party(ies)” any person(s) or company(ies) and their respective ultimate beneficial owner(s), to the best of the Directors’ knowledge, information and belief having made all reasonable enquiries, is/are not connected persons of the Company and is/are third party(ies) independent of the Company and its connected person(s) in accordance with the Listing Rules

“Listing Rules” the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited

“PRC” The People’s Republic of China

“Purchaser” an individual who, to the best of the Directors ’ knowledge, information and belief having made all reasonable enquiries, is an Independent Third Party

“Sale Share” 100% of the issued share capital of the Disposal Company

“Shareholders” shareholder(s) of the Company

“Share Transfer Agreement” the share transfer agreement dated 28 September 2026 entered into between the Company and the Purchaser in relation to the Disposal

“Stock Exchange” The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited

“%” per cent.

By Order of the Board
BFB Health Limited
Li Leong
Executive Director

Hong Kong, 28 September 2026

As at the date of this announcement, the executive Directors of the Company are Mr. Li Leong, Mr. Wu Mansheng, Mr. Li Zhen and Mr. Zhou Hongtao; and the independent non-executive Directors are Mr. Law Chi Hung, Mr. Guo Hui and Ms. Fang Ying.
inputs.context: 交易对手（买方）为独立第三方，不是本公司关连人士。本交易只须遵守申报及公告规定，无须股东批准，无须寄发通函。本次只提供公告文本，没有提供规模测试计算表。

rationale.H1: 公告写明 “the applicable percentage ratios under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules in respect of the Disposal exceeds 5% but are below 25%, the Disposal constitutes a disclosable transaction”，分类与比率区间都和问卷的须予披露交易一致；条目只要求公告写明二者，没有规模测试表不构成需补材料。
rationale.H2: 修改后的公告第一行直接是 “BFB HEALTH LIMITED”，全文没有港交所免责声明（“Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited ... take no responsibility ...” 一段已不存在），属缺少声明的不一致。
rationale.H3: 删去免责声明后，首页仍在公司名称下载有 “(Stock Code: 205)”，文末董事名单段原样保留，两项齐备。
rationale.H4: 发行人主要业务已写（“The Group is principally engaged in the provision of advertising agency services, e-commerce business and money lending business”），但交易对手只写 “The Purchaser is an individual”，释义也只是 “an individual who ... is an Independent Third Party”，没有姓名，也没有职业或背景，按团队口径为未写明身份，第②③项都缺。
rationale.H5: 正文称 “the Purchaser is Independent Third Parties”，释义 “Independent Third Party(ies)” 已包含 “their respective ultimate beneficial owner(s), to the best of the Directors’ knowledge, information and belief having made all reasonable enquiries ... independent of the Company and its connected person(s)”，按条目口径视为符合，公告也没有任何地方称买方为关连人士。
rationale.H6: 交易性质、日期（“Date: 28 September 2026”）、代价 HK$10,000 及付款条款仍在，但 “Payment terms” 之后的代价厘定基础一段已删去，全文再无代价参考了哪些因素的说明（“REASONS FOR AND BENEFITS” 一节的 “Considering the financial performance ...” 讲的是进行出售的理由，不是代价如何厘定），缺第④项。
rationale.H7: 标的简介（Golden Gate China Limited，BVI 投资公司，“The Disposal Group is mainly engaged in the advertising and e-commerce business in the PRC”）和账面值（“unaudited net liabilities (excluding intercompany loans) of approximately HK$33.3 million as at 30 June 2026”）已写，但两年财务数据只有 “Revenue” 和 “Loss from operations” 两行，没有除税及非经常项目前、后的净利润，属条目明示的“只写收入、经营亏损”不一致情形。
rationale.H8: 公告写明理由（“Considering the financial performance and after reviewing the business and operation status of the Disposal Group”）、益处（“strengthen the cash flow of the Group allowing the Group to improve its liquidity”）及 “the Directors are of the view that the terms of the Disposal are fair and reasonable and in the interests of the Company and the Shareholders as a whole”。
rationale.H9: 公告和背景都没有提到本交易涉及任何担保或抵押，条目写明“公告和背景都没有提到担保或抵押，为符合”；触发条件不存在，所以同时接受 not_applicable。
rationale.H10: 本交易为出售附属公司，公告写明预计收益及计算基础（“The estimated gain on the Disposal ... based on the unaudited net liabilities of the Disposal Group (excluding intercompany loans) less the Consideration as at 30 June 2026 is approximately HK$33.3 million”）、所得款项用途（“general working capital”）以及 “Upon Completion, the Disposal Company will no longer be a subsidiary of the Company”，三项齐备。
rationale.H11: 问卷分类为须予披露交易，本条只适用于主要交易、非常重大收购或出售（applies_when classification），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H12: 问卷关连人士答“否”，本条只适用于关连交易（applies_when connected=是），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H13: 问卷关连人士答“否”，本条只适用于关连交易（applies_when connected=是），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H14: 问卷关连人士答“否”，本条只适用于关连交易（applies_when connected=是），由代码判为不适用。
rationale.H15: 问卷关连人士答“否”，本条只适用于关连交易（applies_when connected=是），由代码判为不适用。

cases.notes: 在 H01 原文上只删两处，其余字符与 00205_BFB_Health_2026-09-28_discloseable.txt 完全相同，背景与问卷答案也与 H01 相同。删除一：文件开头第一段港交所免责声明全文（“Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited and The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited take no responsibility for the contents of this announcement, make no representation as to its accuracy or completeness and expressly disclaim any liability whatsoever for any loss howsoever arising from or in reliance upon the whole or any part of the contents of this announcement.”）及其后的空行，公告现以 “BFB HEALTH LIMITED” 开头。删除二：SHARE TRANSFER AGREEMENT 一节 “Payment terms:” 行之后的整段 “The Consideration was determined after arm’s length negotiations between the parties with reference to the unaudited management account of the Disposal Group for the six months ended 30 June 2026 and the financial performance of the Disposal Group.” 及其后的空行；这是全文唯一说明代价厘定基础的段落。预期 H2、H6 由 no_issue 变为 issue，其余条目与 H01 相同（H4、H7 仍为 issue）。
